requests.request_prompt:
Select every record whose flag is KEEP, and omit every record whose flag is DROP. Copy both the ID and its three-digit value exactly. Return one JSON object with a records array, sorted by ID. Each item has string fields id and value. Do not add commentary or any other field.
Example only, not part of the input:
R9001 value=271 flag=KEEP
R9002 value=583 flag=DROP
R9003 value=946 flag=KEEP
The example answer would be {"records":[{"id":"R9001","value":"271"},{"id":"R9003","value":"946"}]}. These example IDs do not occur in the actual input.
Output schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"records":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^R[0-9]{4}$"},"value":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[0-9]{3}$"}},"required":["id","value"],"additionalProperties":false}}},"required":["records"],"additionalProperties":false}
